messages:
ashley: Heads-up — Meridian on-prem customer wants to cutover Wed 2026-04-20. Need final network gating checklist + air-gap plan. Who owns the remaining items?

matt: I can own network gating. Current blockers: missing explicit egress rules for our telemetry proxy + customer needs TLS-mutual config for registry pull.

devon: Installer/oomph team: the offline installer flow is green, but we still need to validate package signing with the customer's air-gapped ATS. Waiting on cert exchange.

irene: Security/compliance: I flagged KMS/HSM integration for the private deploy. Customer requires HSM-backed keywrap for at-rest keys — do we have an integration owner?

ryan: Docs/runbook: I'll update the runbook once owners confirm final ports/IPs and certs. Can someone drop the minimal CIDR list? I'll also add rollback steps.

ashley: Owners summary so far: matt=network gating, devon=installer/airgap packaging, irene=KMS/HSM & compliance, ryan=runbook/docs, tara=customer coord. @tara can you confirm customer schedule?

tara: Confirmed — Meridian signed for Wed EOD (PST) cutover window. They want canary on Mon for smoke tests. I'll coordinate cert exchange today.

matt: Minimal egress we need from nodes: 3.12.45.0/24 (registry mirror), 34.198.12.0/24 (telemetry proxy), 54.23.10.0/24 (billing webhook). SSH only from bastion CIDR. I'll paste a snippet below for firewall rules.

```
# iptables-like example for their network team
-A OUTPUT -d 3.12.45.0/24 -j ACCEPT # registry mirror
-A OUTPUT -d 34.198.12.0/24 -j ACCEPT # telemetry
-A OUTPUT -d 54.23.10.0/24 -j ACCEPT # webhook
-A INPUT -s 10.20.30.0/24 -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT # bastion
```

devon: Installer note: the offline bundle uses signed artifacts (sha256 + sig). We need the customer's public cert (PEM) to verify signatures. Tara, can you get that?

tara: On it — I asked Meridian to upload PEM to the secure exchange. ETA 4 hours.

irene: For HSM: we have a prototype with vendor X (pkcs11 adapter). That's not GA. Do we accept a prototype in the field or require vendor-certified HSM? Meridian requires FIPS 140-2 Level 2. I'll confirm if vendor X qualifies.

matt: If HSM isn't GA, fallback is to use customer-managed KMS endpoints over VPC endpoints. Need network team to confirm private link options. @matt -> handing to @ashley for escalation if needed.

ashley: Escalation path noted. If HSM not suitable, we run KMS via VPC endpoint. Devon — can installer accept remote KMS endpoints during initial bootstrap?

devon: Yes, installer supports remote KMS endpoints; we need endpoint URL + auth token. That will be part of the env manifest.

ryan: Code/PR status: network gating PRs — matt, what's the PR number? Need to link in runbook.

matt: PR #4821 (network: firewall + vpc endpoints). Needs one more review from @irene for security comments.

irene: I'll review today. Quick comment: require mTLS for telemetry, add cert rotation notes.

ops-bot: Deployment window reminder — Meridian cutover scheduled 2026-04-20 23:00-02:00 UTC. Canary window 2026-04-18 08:00-12:00 UTC.

ashley: Action items (short):
- matt: finalize PR #4821 + post final CIDR list (due end of day)
- devon: prepare offline bundle verification step + handle PEM (due +6h)
- irene: confirm HSM vendor compliance or sign-off KMS fallback (due +12h)
- ryan: update runbook with firewall snippet + rollback steps (after matt finalizes)
- tara: get PEM from customer and confirm canary schedule (due +4h)

matt: pinging @irene for review on #4821 — small changes left.

irene: Reviewing now, pushed a tiny policy tweak. Approve after CI passes.

devon: If PEM arrives, I'll run local verification against the bundle and post results here.

tara: PEM uploaded to secure exchange (link: https://vault.internal/meridian/pem) — Meridian also confirmed their proxy requires TLS1.3.

devon: Verified bundle locally with customer's PEM, sha256 matches. No signature errors. Posting logs: `installer verify --bundle meridian-offline.tgz --pubkey meridian.pem` -> OK

ryan: Added firewall snippet to runbook draft and a quick rollback: `scale down canary -> revert dns -> remove customer routes` (will flesh out).

ashley: Great. We'll reconvene tomorrow if any blockers remain. If HSM falls through, escalate to infra leads. :thumbsup:

matt: CI on #4821 failed on linting, pushing fix now.

irene: Approved after lint fix.

ops-bot: CI status — PR #4821 passed (lint + integration smoke).

ashley: Closing loop — all owners, please update their tickets: NET-317 (matt), INST-204 (devon), SEC-129 (irene), DOC-88 (ryan), CUST-45 (tara). We'll mark on-call aware.

tara: Noted, customer informed about canary Monday. Thanks everyone.

matt: Leaving a last note: monitoring alert thresholds for canary = 2x baseline error rate for 5m -> auto rollback. I'll add to runbook.

ryan: Added monitoring section. Thread resolved?

ashley: Resolved for now. Re-open if anything changes. :rocket:
